back.es: to treat; to try (tratar de + infinitive); to be about (tratar de/sobre, of a book, film or topic)

note: The hint "a story or topic, with de" points to tratar de and keeps this card apart from the "to try" and "to treat" cards; a learner might also think of the related tratarse de ("se trata de"), but that means "it's a matter of" and does not fit a story's topic as well.
